Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I am afraid the [Clever Woman](/book/58) cannot come out till March, as [Hogg](/organisation/159) gives me no hope of finishing her before that time—so it would be hardly worth while to begin printing her till the beginning of the year.
I have sent all the rest of the [Golden Deeds](/book/51) direct to the printers, they will end with [Dr.

Kane.](/person/1915)

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
